title: Trying to pin down the dates of his moves
summary: Allen and Mazzari struggle over what year he returned to the US and came to New Orleans; Mazzari says about 1938 and about 1948 and admits he is bad with dates.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: And, uh, what year was that?
Well, you had how many years in Indianapolis?
And you came here back to this country what year? Yeah.
Uh, thirty-nine, no, thirty-eight. Thirty-eight. Something like that.
How long were you, was it before you got with the Indianapolis Symphony?
Well, I was with them nine years.
Yeah, but when you came back to this country, you didn't get with them immediately, huh?
Well, actually, within the year. Within the year.
Oh, yeah. So, let's see. Was, uh, then it was, uh, forty-eight when you came down here, huh?
